patch_list: Stops Google Play's Automatic Integrity Protection (PairIP) license check that, on a re-signed/sideloaded build, redirects the app to the Play Store ("get it on Google Play"). Neuters both entry points of com.pairip.licensecheck.LicenseCli…
Changes the app name shown under the launcher icon. Set the desired name in the patch options.

Stops native Sentry crash/telemetry upload by neutering the Capacitor Sentry plugin's native init (io.sentry.capacitor.SentryCapacitor.initNativeSdk), so it resolves without starting the native Sentry SDK. Firebase auth, ConfigCat and push…
Removes the advertising-id and Ad Services (Privacy Sandbox) permissions so the device advertising id, Topics, Attribution and Custom Audience signals cannot be read for ad tracking.
